variants.name: 3 ml
variants.about_this_item: SexControl Spot-On is a veterinary hormonal preparation for regulating sexual heat in female cats, applied as drops on the withers. During heat, cats often behave badly — they meow a lot and loudly, mark the home and try to escape — because of high levels of sex hormones. SexControl is prescribed to female cats to delay heat or to interrupt heat that has already started; it suits owners who do not plan to spay the cat, to prevent unwanted pregnancy and to correct unwanted behaviour. Drops on the withers are a convenient way to give the preparation, especially to aggressive or timid cats, and do not stress the animal. Active substances: megestrol acetate 2.5% and ethinylestradiol 0.02%; excipients: menthol, vitamin E and diethylene glycol monoethyl ether. Dosage form: solution for external use, 3 ml in a dropper bottle, packed in a carton with instructions. Contraindicated in diseases of the urogenital system, tumours, diabetes mellitus, and in sexually immature, pregnant and lactating animals. Hormonal medicine — read the instructions carefully and consult a veterinarian before use. Store closed in the original pack, dry, away from direct sunlight and food, at 5–30 °C, out of reach of children; after opening, use within 6 months.
variants.ingredient_information: Active substances: megestrol acetate 2.5%, ethinylestradiol 0.02%. Excipients: menthol, vitamin E, diethylene glycol monoethyl ether.
variants.feeding_instructions: Apply to the skin at one point on the back of the neck (withers), between the shoulder blades, where the cat cannot lick it. To delay heat (between heats): 2 drops for a cat up to 5 kg, 4 drops for 5–10 kg, once a week, for no more than 18 months in a row; repeat the course only after the cat has shown a normal sexual cycle. To interrupt heat: at the first signs (no later than 2 days after onset), 4 drops for a cat up to 5 kg, 8 drops for 5–10 kg, once a day for 4–7 days (until the signs disappear, plus one day). Do not stop the course early.
